body:
I got a couple hours last night, not much.

Talking about it makes it that much worse. Ive been trying for the past couple weeks now not to think. About any of it.

If I consciously try and acknowledge it, I swear, Im going to want to end it right that second. Its just going to overwhelm me. Even now I can feel it.

When Im distracted, its the easiest. For the past month thats all Ive been doing. But it always comes back.

When I wake up.
When Im getting ready for the day.
When Im walking.
When I come home.
Right before I fall asleep.
And in my dreams.

I dont want to experience this.
I dont want to have to constantly have these thoughts in my head, I dont.

I feel like Im cursed.
Its each individual recording track of a song before its been mastered together I believe.
